safety_security_measures_007.evidence: Article 12 D: 'The Board will put its full support behind the policies it adopts in matters of discipline, disruptive and/or unauthorized visitors.' Article 10 C: 'direct communications link from each classroom... to the office for reporting crises and getting help.' Article 12 G: 'Unit members in every school in the county may intervene in any fight or physical struggle which takes place in their presence in any school building or on the school grounds' Article 12 A: 'The right of individuals to protect themselves and others consistent with the law shall not be denied to unit members as a condition of their employment.'
